canonical_project: Fleet Data Centers South Valley Campus
aliases: Fleet Data Centers South Valley Campus
Tahoe Reno Industrial Center South Valley

location.site: South Valley Technology Park / Tahoe Reno Industrial Center, southern USA Parkway area

status_as_of_cutoff: site work-construction (reported) with active state utility/environmental approvals pending: Fleet/Tract broke ground on South Valley in May 2026 and local reporting says Fleet plans a 200 MW data center there. PUCN records show South Valley applications for a 345 kV substation/four-line interconnection, a temporary 144 MW natural-gas generation facility, and NV Energy large-load electric service agreements with SV RNO Property Owner 1, LLC; NDEP lists a pending Class I New OPTC air-quality application for SV RNO. No commission order, county building permit, certificate of occupancy, energization, or live-service record was located in this refresh.
evidence_grade: B: PUCN, NDEP, GOED/Storey County official records confirm active permitting/abatement/service-agreement processes; construction status and 200 MW campus figure rely on company/local reporting.

actions.result_status: Docket 25-01037: Reno Power NR 1, LLC applied for a permit to construct the South Valley Phase 1 development, including a new 345 kV Mackay Switching Station and two single-circuit 345 kV segments on private land in Storey County.
actions.access_caveat: PUCN public docket index; status/order documents were not independently retrieved in this refresh.

actions.government_body: Storey County Board of County Commissioners
actions.result_status: County minutes show a 3-0 motion directing staff to submit a letter to GOED acknowledging SV RNO Property Owner 1, LLC's data center sales/use and personal-property tax abatement application for operations planned in Storey County.
actions.access_caveat: County acknowledgement of GOED abatement application; not a building permit or land-use approval.

actions.government_body: Nevada Governor's Office of Economic Development
actions.result_status: GOED agenda listed SV RNO Property Owner 1 LLC for Data Center Sales and Use Tax Abatement and Data Center Personal Property Tax Abatement; published minutes identify SV RNO representatives at the meeting.
actions.access_caveat: Agenda/minutes confirm the matter was before GOED; detailed approval terms should be rechecked against the final abatement contract or board packet if needed.

actions.result_status: Docket 26-04007: SV RNO Property Owner 1, LLC applied for a permit to construct a new 345 kV substation, four 345 kV transmission lines to interconnect with the Mackay Switching Station, and associated facilities on private land in Storey County.
actions.access_caveat: PUCN pending docket index; no approval order located.

actions.result_status: NDEP pending AQOP table lists SV RNO Property Owner 1, LLC in Storey County with permit AP7374-5094, Class 1, Air Case 12882, New OPTC, with 30-day public notice planned.
actions.access_caveat: Pending-applications table only; final permit issuance was not found.

actions.result_status: Docket 26-04026: SV RNO Property Owner 1 LLC applied to construct the South Valley Temporary Power Generation Facility, a temporary 144 MW natural-gas-fueled electric generating facility and associated facilities on private land in Storey County.
actions.access_caveat: PUCN pending docket index and calendar records; no final approval order located.

actions.government_body: Fleet Data Centers (company/finance report; not a government body)
actions.result_status: Local business reporting described Fleet's $4.6 billion financing through senior secured notes for the projects and a long-term lease/customer context; financing does not establish county approval or power service.
actions.access_caveat: The accessible report combines financing and later groundbreaking information; no underlying permit is published.

actions.government_body: Fleet Data Centers / Tract (reported by KOLO and Northern Nevada Business Weekly; not a government body)
actions.result_status: KOLO reported Fleet and Tract broke ground on a 2 million square foot, $4.6 billion South Valley data center in Storey County; Northern Nevada Business Weekly later reported Fleet broke ground on the second TRIC campus and would construct a 200 MW data center at South Valley.
actions.access_caveat: Press reports; construction status is not a substitute for final utility, air, building, CO, or energization records.

actions.result_status: Docket 26-05027: Sierra Pacific Power Company d/b/a NV Energy applied for approval of Large Load Electric Service Agreements with PR RNO Property Owner 1, LLC and SV RNO Property Owner 1, LLC.
actions.access_caveat: PUCN pending docket index; agreement details may include confidential material.

capacity_mw.notes: 200 MW South Valley campus and 86 MW initial load are reported by Northern Nevada Business Weekly; 144 MW temporary generation is from PUCN Docket 26-04026; 1,215 MW is Tract's marketed South Valley Technology Park buildout capacity, not confirmed energized IT load.

owner: Fleet Data Centers / Tract Capital Management; project filings use SV RNO Property Owner 1, LLC for South Valley.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.details: Sources use different capacity bases: local reporting says Fleet will construct a 200 MW South Valley data center and cites 86 MW initial load; PUCN self-generation docket is 144 MW temporary generation; Tract markets the broader South Valley Technology Park at 1,215 MW buildout capacity. These should not be treated as the same metric.
Local reporting supports groundbreaking/site work, while PUCN and NDEP records remain application/pending surfaces in this refresh. No energization or final-service record was found.
